# cairn admin connector enable

Mark a connector enabled (gates the poll loop)

## Help

```text
Mark a connector enabled (gates the poll loop)

Usage: cairn admin connector enable [OPTIONS] --actor <actor> <name>

Arguments:
  <name>  Connector name

Options:
      --actor <actor>         Operator identity wire form (e.g. hmn:alice)
      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>  Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides
                              CAIRN_VAULT)
  -h, --help                  Print help
```
